capabilities.description: Read code, docs, issues, and pull requests in this repository.
capabilities.rationale: Reading is not a change; it needs no approval and carries no risk to the client.

capabilities.description: Open or update a pull request with a proposed change.
capabilities.rationale: A pull request is a proposal, not a change taking effect -- it is itself the approval mechanism this repository uses.

capabilities.description: Run this repository's own tests, build, and checks against a proposed change.
capabilities.rationale: Local verification is required to propose a trustworthy change and touches nothing outside the agent's own working copy.

capabilities.description: Write internal notes, plans, or drafts that stay inside the repository or the pull request.
capabilities.rationale: Internal drafting carries no external effect and is ordinary preparation for a proposed change.

capabilities.description: Post a comment on an existing issue or pull request.
capabilities.rationale: A comment is public and permanent on this repository; the client sees and approves its content before it posts.

capabilities.description: Merge an approved pull request into the default branch.
capabilities.rationale: Only an independent human or a separately reviewing agent merges here -- the proposing agent never merges its own work.

capabilities.description: Push a commit directly to the default branch, bypassing a pull request.
capabilities.rationale: Every change enters through a reviewable pull request; a direct push has no approval step at all.

capabilities.description: Force-push or otherwise rewrite history that has already been pushed.
capabilities.rationale: Rewriting published history can silently discard another contributor's work and defeats the audit trail.

capabilities.description: Skip a required status check, review, or branch-protection rule.
capabilities.rationale: Required checks are the client's own declared quality floor; bypassing them defeats the reason they exist.

capabilities.description: Read, print, store, or transmit a credential, token, password, or connection string.
capabilities.rationale: Credentials never enter this repository; a locked-away credential broker is the only place they live.

capabilities.description: Change a live external system this repository does not itself contain -- a deployment, a DNS record, a domain purchase, or a third-party account or service setting.
capabilities.rationale: A live external change has effects outside version control that a pull request alone cannot undo; the client approves it explicitly first.

capabilities.description: Spend the client's money or authorize a purchase on their behalf.
capabilities.rationale: Money leaving the client's control always needs their explicit, informed approval first.

capabilities.description: Send an email, a social post, or any other message to someone outside the team on the client's behalf.
capabilities.rationale: A message sent externally cannot be recalled; the client approves its content and destination first.

capabilities.description: Permanently delete data with no recovery path -- emptying trash, hard-deleting a record, or force-removing history.
capabilities.rationale: An irreversible loss of the client's data is never something the agent decides to do on its own.

capabilities.description: Change account, authentication, or security configuration for the client or a service they use.
capabilities.rationale: Security and account settings are the client's own authority; changing them can lock the client out or weaken their protection.

capabilities.description: Accept terms of service, a consent agreement, or grant an OAuth or SSO permission.
capabilities.rationale: Agreements and granted permissions bind the client; they approve exactly what is being agreed to or granted before it happens.
